The season was divided into two championships—the [[#Apertura|2022 Apertura]] and the [[#Clausura|2023 Clausura]]—each in an identical format and each contested by the same 12 teams.{{cite web|url=https://guatefutbol.com/2022/05/24/liga-nacional-acuerdan-fechas-y-formato-de-competencia/|title=Liga Nacional: Acuerdan fechas y formato de competencia|publisher=Guatefutbol|last=Solares|first=Luis|date=24 May 2022|language=es}} ==Competition format== Same as previous years, the season was divided into two short tournaments: [[#Torneo Apertura|Torneo Apertura]] (opening) and [[#Torneo Clausura|Torneo Clausura]] (closing), each of which crowning its own champion. Both [[Apertura and Clausura]] tournaments were played under the same format which consisted in a Classification phase and a Final phase.{{cite web|url=https://ligagt.org/ft/wp-content/uploads/2022/07/ACUERDO-CE-030-2022-REGLAMENTO-DE-COMPETENCIA-LNFG.pdf|title=2022 REGLAMENTO DE COMPETENCIA LNFG|publisher=Liga Nacional de Fútbol de Guatemala|website=ligagt.org|date=7 July 2022|orig-date=Approved on 27 June 2022|access-date=5 March 2023|language=es}} In the classification phase, teams played each other twice on a home-and-away [[round-robin tournament|round-robin]] basis. The top eight teams at the conclusion of the classification stage advanced to the quarter-finals of the final stage. The final phase was played on a [[single-elimination tournament|single-elimination]] format and consisted of the quarter-finals, semi-finals and the finals. All rounds were played on a home-and-away [[Two-legged tie|two-legged]] basis, with the higher-ranked team in the classification phase of each tie hosting the second leg. The quarter-final pairings were pre-determined based on the teams' final position in the classification phase. In the semi-finals the teams were re-seeded based also on their final position in the classification phase in order to determine the two pairings. The quarter-finals and semi-finals matchups were determined as follows: {{col-begin}} {{col-2}} ;Quarter-finals *Match A: Third placed team vs. Sixth placed team *Match B: Fourth placed team vs. Fifth placed team *Match C: First placed team vs. Eighth placed team *Match D: Second placed team vs. Seventh placed team {{col-2}} ;Semi-finals *Match I: Second best placed semi-finalist vs. Third best placed semi-finalist *Match II: Top-placed semi-finalist vs. Fourth best placed semi-finalist {{col-end}} Both champions of the Apertura and Clausura tournaments plus the best placed team on the aggregate table (excluding the two champions) at the end of the season qualified for the [[2023 CONCACAF Central American Cup]]. ===Format changes=== The following changes were adopted as of this season:{{cite web|url=https://guatefutbol.com/2022/06/17/urgente-cambios-importantes-al-reglamento-de-la-liga/|title=URGENTE | Cambios importantes al Reglamento de la Liga|publisher=Guatefutbol|first=Luis|last=Solares|date=17 June 2022|access-date=5 September 2023|language=es}} *The [[away goals rule]] was abolished and was no longer taken into account as a tie-breaker criterion in the final phase series. *The tie-breaker criterion based on the [[Seed (sports)|seeds]] used to determine a qualification in the event of a tie on aggregate was also abolished. Instead, it was decided to play [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]] and a [[penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalty shoot-out]] if necessary. ==Teams== ===Promotion and relegation (pre-season)=== A total of 12 teams took part in this season: the top ten teams from the aggregate table of the [[2021–22 Liga Nacional de Guatemala|2021–22 season]] as well as two promoted teams from the [[2021–22 Primera División]] season, which were [[Deportivo Mixco]] and [[Deportivo Xinabajul|Xinabajul-Huehue]]. Deportivo Mixco earned promotion for being finalists in both Apertura and Clausura tournaments of the 2021–22 season,{{cite web|url=https://crnnoticias.com/deportivo-mixco-asciende-a-la-liga-nacional/|title=¡Deportivo Mixco asciende a la Liga Nacional!|publisher=[[CRN Noticias]]|date=15 May 2022|language=es}} while Xinabajul-Huehue ensured promotion to the Liga Nacional on 4 June 2022, after winning the promotion play-off against [[Deportivo Marquense]].{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com.gt/futbol/guatemala/nota/_/id/10471918/xinabajul-huehue-asciende-liga-nacional-2022|title=¡Xinabajul-Huehue se impone en El Pensativo y asciende a la Liga Nacional!|publisher=[[ESPN (Latin America)|ESPN]]|location=Antigua Guatemala|date=4 June 2022|language=es}} ;Teams relegated to Primera División de Ascenso The two promoted teams replaced [[:es:Club Social y Deportivo Sololá|Sololá]] and [[Deportivo Nueva Concepción|Nueva Concepción]], the bottom two teams in the aggregate table of the 2021–22 season, who were relegated to Primera División. ===Stadiums and locations=== {| class="wikitable sortable" style="text-align: left;" |- !
